no official rule from me, but sounds like your shop owner is playing Mr.
Powerful, and feeling good about it.
It's silly not to see someone equip themselves with an Ivory Bow...allows
you the chance to block it. After all the Meth is paying pool to
influence that weapon to that vampire/minion. Same thing goes with
recruiting allies and retainers. Any minion should be able to block it if
they can(see it happening).

However, it does sound like an interesting variant that only adds to the
mystery to me.

dustin
